exposure: days of age at first blood transfusion
cohort: The study included 150 very low and extremely low birth weight infants who received blood transfusions.
finding: The younger the days of age at first blood transfusion, the higher the risk of intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH) in very low and extremely low birth weight infants.
mod_finding: Spontaneous delivery was identified as a risk factor for intraventricular hemorrhage.
birth_weight: very low birth weight (VLBW) and extremely low birth weight (ELBW)
